description: Erection of a single storey side and rear infill extension replacing existing garage, first floor side extension
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [230716//02 Rev A, 230716/03 Rev A, 230716/04 Rev A, 230716/05 Rev A, 230716/06 Rev A, 230716/07 Rev A, 230716/08 Rev A, 230716/10 Rev A received 18 July 2025
230716/11 Rev E, 230716/12 Rev C, 230716/13 Rev C, 230716/14 Rev C, 230716/15 Rev C, 230716/16 Rev C, 230716/17 Rev A, 230716/40 Rev A, Fire statement, received 21 October 2025
].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the [eastern and western] elevation of the development hereby permitted.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy.
